mentions.name: KeyleSSH
mentions.description: A keyless SSH/PAM prototype that removes the private key file entirely so there is no single credential sitting around for attackers to steal.
mentions.problem: Private key files sitting around are a single thing for attackers to steal.
mentions.audience: Software developers who need usable security tooling with a familiar developer experience
mentions.source_excerpt: Another is KeyleSSH, a keyless SSH/PAM prototype where there is no private key file sitting around as one thing to steal: https://github.com/sashyo/keylessh
